properties.label: Recordings page: [CONTEXT_PATH]/blackbox/  ·  Admins can always upload, view and delete.

properties.name: deletePermission
properties.label: Who can delete any recording
properties.description: Empty = admins only. Applies to the recordings they can view.

properties.name: ownerAccess
properties.label: Uploaders can view and delete their own recordings

properties.name: maxSizeMb
properties.label: Max file size (MB)
properties.description: Applies to the video and to session.json separately.
properties.validation_message: Enter a whole number of MB.

properties.label: System logs: the extension tags the recorded tab's requests, and their Joget log lines are kept with the recording.

properties.name: systemLogPermission
properties.label: Who can view system logs
properties.description: Empty = admins only. They must also be able to view the recording.

properties.name: ownServerData
properties.label: Uploaders can view the server data of their own recordings
properties.description: System logs, traces, server load and System Info (license key, system properties). No = only the users above.

properties.name: systemLogMaxMb
properties.label: Max size of system logs per recording (MB)
properties.description: Lines after this are dropped; the viewer says the log was cut off.
properties.validation_message: Enter a whole number of MB.

properties.name: systemLogKeepDays
properties.label: Delete system logs not uploaded after (days)
properties.description: Captured lines wait on the server until the recording is uploaded.
properties.validation_message: Enter a whole number of days.

properties.name: captureGauges
properties.label: Sample server load during recordings
properties.description: Needs "Capture system logs during recordings". Every second: heap, GC time, CPU, busy request threads and database connections, shown as the Server load strip.

properties.name: captureTraces
properties.label: Copy Glowroot traces of slow and failed requests
properties.description: Needs "Capture system logs during recordings". Glowroot's own slow threshold decides which requests have a trace; it is not changed.

properties.name: captureGlowrootData
properties.label: Copy Glowroot data for the recording
properties.description: Needs "Capture system logs during recordings" and Glowroot 0.14 on each node. About a minute after a recording stops, each node cuts the recording out of its Glowroot data, in Glowroot's own format: the traces of the recorded requests, plus the aggregates and gauges of all traffic during the recording. Download it on the replay page and open it in a standalone Glowroot. Each build needs free disk space in Joget's temp folder of about the size of Glowroot's data.h2.db (it is skipped, with the reason, when there is not enough).

properties.name: glowrootUrl
properties.label: Glowroot address
properties.description: Empty = the Glowroot agent of this Joget (found from its admin.json, usually http://localhost:4000). Read as Glowroot's anonymous user.
